content.value_statement: Errors and incidents are hard to triage when evidence is spread across logs, stack traces, and services. This skill structures diagnosis, parses logs, identifies patterns, and guides minimal fixes.
actual_capabilities: Analyze error messages and stack traces to identify likely failure points.
Parse local log files with the included helper script and summarize recurring errors.
Correlate errors across timelines, deployments, services, and traffic patterns.
Recognize common patterns such as N+1 queries, memory leaks, race conditions, and timeouts.
Guide minimal fixes, verification steps, and prevention recommendations.
Provide an incident postmortem template for root cause and action item documentation.
limitations: Requires relevant logs, stack traces, error messages, or code context from the user.
Does not replace observability platforms, profilers, test runners, or production access controls.
The helper script reads local text logs only and does not query remote services.
Production fixes and incident conclusions still need human review before deployment.

use_cases.title: Investigate Production Errors
use_cases.description: Triage error spikes, correlate them with deployments, and identify likely root causes.

use_cases.title: Fix Test Failures
use_cases.description: Read failing assertions, trace expected behavior, and propose focused fixes with verification steps.

use_cases.title: Analyze Incident Evidence
use_cases.description: Turn logs, timelines, and symptoms into a clear postmortem and prevention plan.

prompt_templates.title: Explain This Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Debug this error. Explain the likely cause, what evidence supports it, and the smallest safe fix.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze These Logs
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these log excerpts. Group recurring errors, identify timelines, and list the most likely root causes.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a Test Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate this failing test. Compare expected and actual behavior, then propose a minimal code or test change.

prompt_templates.title: Build Incident Root Cause
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these logs, deployment notes, and symptoms to produce a root cause analysis with evidence and action items.

output_examples.input: A TypeError occurs when loading a user profile page.
output_examples.output: The analysis identifies a missing user object, explains the failing assumption, and recommends a null check with a regression test.

output_examples.input: Database connection errors increased after a deployment.
output_examples.output: The output groups the errors by time, links them to connection pool pressure, and lists verification and rollback checks.

output_examples.input: A team needs a postmortem after an outage.
output_examples.output: The response organizes impact, timeline, root cause, contributing factors, and follow-up actions for review.

best_practices: Provide full error messages, stack traces, timestamps, and recent change context.
Redact secrets, tokens, personal data, and customer content before sharing logs.
Verify each proposed fix with a reproduction case and regression tests.
anti_patterns: Do not debug from partial screenshots when text logs or stack traces are available.
Do not apply broad refactors before isolating the specific failing assumption.
Do not treat correlation with a deployment as proof without supporting evidence.

faq.question: What kinds of issues can this skill debug?
faq.answer: It supports application errors, test failures, stack traces, logs, incidents, performance symptoms, and common distributed system failures.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents local commands and a helper script, but command execution depends on the user environment and approval flow.

faq.question: Can it analyze production logs?
faq.answer: Yes, when the user provides logs or approved local files. Sensitive data should be redacted before analysis.

faq.question: Does it replace an observability platform?
faq.answer: No. It helps interpret evidence from tools such as logs, traces, alerts, and metrics.

faq.question: Can it produce incident postmortems?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a structured postmortem template with impact, timeline, root cause, and action items.

faq.question: Which AI tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
